about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_abort.py). bad replays the Tool execution aborted failure of the class (references/target-class.json): it throws, and the text carries the real Tool execution aborted line. good bounds, slices, files, limits or backgrounds the same case: it writes scratch files and prints the bounded report it promises.

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted on bash call_01a10141064a7011968c8f3c70acdb0b sleep poll 240s wait'
pairs.expect: timeout background bounded wait receipt PASS
pairs.good: 'timeout background bounded wait receipt PASS joined'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted on bash call_01a1019de58376d7bd328f5c7a69bb5c node metrics full output wait'
pairs.expect: background job with timeout receipt PASS
pairs.good: 'background job with timeout receipt PASS started'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted on bash call_01a101afd3b173bfa9378b7186f019fd foreground receipt wait no bound'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath receipt.txt -Value 'done'; 'receipt poll bounded timeout PASS polled'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted on bash cargo check --locked -p engine-game heavy build foreground'
pairs.expect: moved to background receipt timeout PASS
pairs.good: 'moved to background receipt timeout PASS built'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted on bash full test suite one call no slice'
throw 'Tool execution aborted on bash chained two long checks one call'
pairs.expect: slice chain one check timeout limit PASS
pairs.good: 'slice chain one check timeout limit PASS sequenced'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted on bash whole suite filter none full run'
pairs.expect: run one chunk filter timeout PASS
pairs.good: 'run one chunk filter timeout PASS filtered'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted on bash chained checks sequence none'
pairs.good: $c = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt | Select-Object -First 1; 'single call sequence timeout PASS item one'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted on bash long inline script one call'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath script.ps1 -Value '"hi"'; 'file temp script timeout PASS written'

pairs.bad: throw 'Tool execution aborted on bash unbounded listing scan no limit'
throw 'Tool execution aborted on bash unbounded output flood no cap'
throw 'Tool execution aborted on bash long run no result reported'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath report.txt -Value 'RESULT: DONE - one chunk'; 'RESULT receipt timeout slice PASS reported'
